items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, there's something else that I told you I saw, I was talking to Emmanuel Sales the other day. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yes, that's your player?

ctx.x: No, not a high note man. In those days trumpet players didn't play high notes. They had more of a running style. You mentioned the trumpet player the other day, Punch. Punch Miller. Do you remember Punch Miller? Sure. Well Punch Miller to me is as near to playing the style that Buddy played than anybody else that I heard. A style similar to what he's playing. Now Punch, don't misunderstand me, now Punch isn't copying Buddy PT. He's playing his style. But he gives you an idea what Buddy actually played. Oh he was…
Oh, there's something else that I told you I saw, I was talking to Emmanuel Sales the other day.
